name: standing forward slide press with towel
description: A standing towel slide on a waist- to chest-height surface that gently trains forward shoulder reach and control.
instructions: Stand facing a stable counter or box and place a towel under your hand on its surface.
Keep your shoulder relaxed and slide the towel forward as your arm reaches out.
Press lightly into the surface, then slide your hand back under control.
Finish the set and switch arms.
